titles.native: 海底都市のできるまで

description:
Special anime produced for Nippon Television's educational program 20th Century Hour.

Depicts a young man's journey towards his lifelong dream of building an "underwater city". Not as a fantasy, but as a realistic life drama.

(Source: Osamu Tezuka's Official Website, translated)
